zabbix.description_raw: Ubiquiti AirOS: Interface ath0(): Ethernet has changed to lower speed than it was before
zabbix.expression_expanded:
change(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.speed[ifSpeed.6])<0 and last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.speed[ifSpeed.6])>0
and (
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=6 or
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=7 or
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=11 or
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=62 or
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=69 or
last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.type[ifType.6])=117
)
and
(last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.status[ifOperStatus.6])<>2)
zabbix.recovery_expression_expanded:
(change(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.speed[ifSpeed.6])>0 and last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.speed[ifSpeed.6],#2)>0) or
(last(/Vibe - AP REUNIAO Ubiquiti/net.if.status[ifOperStatus.6])=2)
zabbix.comments: This Ethernet connection has transitioned down from its known maximum speed. This might be a sign of autonegotiation issues. Acknowledge to close the problem manually.

operational.title: Interfaces de Access Points Ubiquiti com erro ou degradacao
operational.objective: Reagir a erros de interface (ifInErrors) e degradacao de link nos 3 APs Ubiquiti do escritorio.
symptoms: 'Ubiquiti AirOS: Interface athX: High error rate'
'Ubiquiti AirOS: Interface athX: Ethernet has changed to lower speed'
'Ubiquiti AirOS: Interface athX: High bandwidth usage'
actions: [A DEFINIR] Se este grupo de baixo impacto justifica abertura de chamado ou so registro/observacao
operational.meaning: 120 alertas, 56 instancias (ifInErrors.2, .4, .5... por AP), 3 hosts (AP REUNIAO, AP SALA, AP14_VIBE). Severidade: 30 Information, 60 Warning, 30 Average -- nenhum caso Disaster/High, sugerindo que esta familia especifica e majoritariamente de baixo impacto (Wi-Fi de escritorio, nao core de rede).
operational.probable_cause: Interferencia de radio, excesso de clientes conectados ou cabo/porta com problema fisico no AP.
checks_before_action: Confirmar qual AP e interface (nome vem no titulo)
Checar se ha reclamacao de usuario relacionada (rede lenta/instavel na sala)
operational.notes: Rascunho tecnico -- confianca alta, reune 12 familias tecnicas.
